<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in client/cmd. Do not edit. -->

For use as ssh_config's ProxyCommand. Arguments after ProxyCommand should mirror exactly as if you weren't calling ssoossh.

from ssh_config man page
Before: ProxyCommand /usr/bin/nc -X connect -x 192.0.2.0:8080 %h %p
After : ProxyCommand genclidocs ssh ProxyCommand /usr/bin/nc -X connect -x 192.0.2.0:8080 %h %p

NOTICE: Use of ssh key files will not work here as ssh only reads them once at start and will not see our changes to them.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh ssh proxycommand [flags] [args]
```

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoossh`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to the ssoossh config file |
| `--server` | string |  | server address including scheme (e.g. "https://example.com") assumes https if omited. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | count | `0` | trace what the command is doing, to stderr; repeat for more (-v steps, -vv requests and files, -vvv bodies) |
